linkedin.about: Kara Goldin is the Founder of Hint, Inc., best known for its award-winning Hint® water, the leading unsweetened flavored water. She led the company as CEO for 17 years and continues to serve on the Board. She has been named one of InStyle’s Badass 50, Fast Company’s Most Creative People in Business, Fortune’s Most Powerful Women Entrepreneurs, Fortune's Most Innovative Women in Food & Drink and EY Entrepreneur of the Year for Northern California. The Huffington Post listed her as one of six disruptors in business, alongside Steve Jobs and Mark Zuckerberg. Kara has successfully navigated the world of large companies and startups in many industries including media, tech and consumer products. In addition, she understands retail and direct to consumer well. She is an active speaker & writer and hosts the podcast The Kara Goldin Show where she interviews founders, entrepreneurs and other disruptors across various industries. Kara’s first book, Undaunted, was published by Harper Leadership in October 2020 and is now a WSJ and Amazon Best Seller. She lives in the Bay Area. Follow Kara on all social channels @KaraGoldin

Absolutely crazy to think that this week, we launched Episode 900 of The Kara Goldin Show! 🎉🎙️🎧

I couldn’t be more thrilled — or more grateful — to have had the opportunity to bring so many incredible stories to the forefront.

For those who aren’t familiar with the show, we release new episodes three days a week — Monday, Wednesday and Friday. I mostly sit down with founders, often CEOs, and sometimes people who have written a book or two along the way.

We talk about the brands they’re building — or have built — and what really happened along the way. The successes. The failures. The surprises. The people who helped. And, sometimes, the people who made things a whole lot harder.

So many stories. So many favorites.
We cover all kinds of industries, although we spend a lot of time in the consumer world. And after 900 episodes, I’m still amazed by how much there is to learn from people who have actually lived it.who better to learn from?!

So incredibly proud of what we’ve built — and even more grateful to the guests who have been willing to share the real stories behind what they’ve built. The good, the hard and everything in between.

And I couldn’t ask for a better guest for Episode 900: Jessica Herrin — serial entrepreneur and builder behind WeddingChannel, Stella & Dot, and now Marklo.

So much good in this conversation — and so much to learn from Jessica’s journey.
If you haven’t listened before — or you’re just looking for some inspiration and a few great learnings — I hope you’ll give it a listen.

900 episodes. So many incredible stories. And we’re just getting started. ❤️

Have a great week!

#TheKaraGoldinShow #Entrepreneurship #Founders #Episode900 @jessicaherrin @markloai
